name: looped
description: Run your business in Looped from Claude: track time, manage projects and tasks, create and send invoices and credit notes, keep the books in Financials (bank statements, bills, receipts, journals, fixed assets, loans, VAT201, provisional tax, year-end and AFS), prepare and finalise payroll, and set up scheduled routines. Works across every company you belong to. You decide how far each job goes, from draft-only to posting everything that can be reversed.
